Sam: quick midweek check — what I did: reviewed v2 routing doc and merged the rollout gating checklist. blocker: still waiting on QA signoff for spec-321. today: finalize perf targets and lock canary window with infra. @Elaine @Mike can you confirm QA ETA and PR status? link to spec: https://redwood.local/specs/spec-321 :eyes:
Elaine: did a smoke run yesterday, found flaky e2e on retry logic (test: request_retry_flow). opened ticket #432 with logs. ETA for retry fix: EOD today. can also run targeted QA once fix is in. :mag_right:
Mike: working through CRs — PR #789 (model-routing telemetry) is ready for review. will trim payloads per Sam's note. pinging @Jordan for perf numbers before I merge.
Jordan: perf snapshot: regression at 512 tokens on p4d; baseline latency 82ms -> 95ms after current optimizations. investigating quant config + kernel selection. sharing a short snippet: `latency_ms: baseline 82 -> 95`
Nina: blocker: staging dedicated missing KV_CACHE_ENABLED=true in env for the canary namespace, causing cache misses. opened infra ticket and assigned to infra-oncall. I can pair with Elaine for QA tomorrow morning if needed.
release-bot: INFRA: canary capacity booked for 2098770000 UTC (window ~2h). Autoscale policy applied: dedicated-reserve-3.
Sam: plan: Mike/Jordan pair on perf regression today, Elaine/Nina own QA signoff, Sam to finalize perf targets and confirm canary window with infra. if PR #789 is reviewed today, aim to queue canary after QA signoff. :thumbsup:
Mike: ack — will request reviews now and post CI link. @Elaine please paste failing e2e logs into ticket #432 so I can reproduce locally.
Elaine: will paste logs in ~30m and add steps to repro.
Nina: I also added a temporary dashboard tile for retry failures to help QA triage.
Sam: thanks all — piling this into the gating checklist; ping here if any ETA slips.
